mechanism_of_action: The source states that bariatric surgery results in long-term weight loss and improves metabolic syndrome; it does not specify a mechanism of action.
primary_endpoint: Future cancer incidence after bariatric surgery (timepoint not specified).
efficacy_outcome: Bariatric surgery was associated with lower overall cancer incidence (RR 0.62, 95% CI 0.46–0.84; p<0.002) and cancer-associated mortality (RR 0.51, 95% CI 0.42–0.62; p<0.00001) versus conventional treatment.
